formulation.deisdev.preserving_sealant: Protects against melting, decay and weathering.
formulation.deisdev.structural_stasis: Holds supported shapes and gravity blocks in place.
formulation.deisdev.temporal_stasis: Pauses standard ticks and supported transfers.

item.deisdev.preserving_brush.use: Apply the compound in your offhand
item.deisdev.preserving_brush.mode: Sneak-use in air to change mode
overlay.deisdev.need_compound: Hold a compound jar in your offhand
overlay.deisdev.surface_preview: Center first · Some targets may be skipped

config.deisdev.gameplay.description: Adjust serums, enchanting, treatment limits and component trades.
config.deisdev.gameplay.title: Preserve · Gameplay
config.deisdev.gameplay.offline: Join a world to edit. Showing defaults.
config.deisdev.gameplay.unavailable: Settings unavailable. Reopen after joining a compatible world.
config.deisdev.gameplay.readonly: Only the world owner or an admin can edit.
config.deisdev.gameplay.datapack: Using data pack settings. Saving creates a world override.
config.deisdev.gameplay.future: Changes affect new applications and offers. Existing serums keep their speed and time.
config.deisdev.gameplay.stale: Not saved: settings changed. Review the updated values and retry.
config.deisdev.gameplay.invalid: Not saved: check the speed range and experience levels.
config.deisdev.gameplay.io_error: Not saved: could not write the settings file.
config.deisdev.gameplay.busy: Too many requests. Reopen this screen and retry.
config.deisdev.gameplay.multiplier.descr: 2 means twice the supported tick rate. Range: 1.01–8. External clocks and networks keep their normal rate.
config.deisdev.gameplay.suspicious_min.d: Lowest random speed. Must not exceed the maximum.
config.deisdev.gameplay.suspicious_max.d: Highest random speed. Rolled once per application.
config.deisdev.gameplay.duration.descrip: Both serums pause outside ticking chunks. Fractions round to the nearest tick. Maximum: 1,440 minutes.
config.deisdev.gameplay.enchant_level.de: Minimum level to enchant Time Serum into Suspicious Time Serum.
config.deisdev.gameplay.enchant_levels_s: Consumed per enchantment. Must not exceed the required level.
config.deisdev.gameplay.bookshelves.desc: Must have an unobstructed path to the enchanting table.
config.deisdev.gameplay.partial.descript: Allow treatments that leave external clocks, networks or automation partly active.
config.deisdev.gameplay.chunk_limit.desc: Lowering this limit keeps existing treatments.
config.deisdev.gameplay.area_limit.descr: Maximum blocks in a 3×3 application. Range: 1–9.
config.deisdev.gameplay.reset.descriptio: Remove the world override and discard unsaved edits. Existing treatments and offers stay intact.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trades.descripti: Changes affect new offers. Existing villagers keep their trades and stock.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.count.desc: Number of components delivered per purchase.
config.deisdev.gameplay.trade.max_uses.d: Number of times the offer can be used before the villager needs to restock.
Set to 0 to charge only emeralds.
